name: Xmind Agent
summary: Conversational AI inside Xmind that builds and edits mind maps from chat, files and links.
description: Xmind Agent (spotlighted with Xmind 2027 around late Oct 2026) lets users create, research, expand and reorganize mind maps through conversation, ingesting PDFs, webpages, YouTube links and images. Also ships Xmind MCP and a ChatGPT plugin so other agents can read/edit maps. Available on web, desktop and Android. Freemium: Free $0 and Pro ~$4.92/mo (annual) include limited AI credits; Premium ~$8.25/mo adds monthly AI credits.
features: Create, expand and reorganize mind maps by chat
Ingests PDFs, webpages, YouTube links and images
